task: Responde el correo como si fueras Maya (6 a 8 frases): cuenta tus planes con be going to y responde a la invitación.
paragraphs: Thanks for your message! I'm so happy the school year is nearly over. I've got big plans for the summer.

First, I'm going to work in my uncle's restaurant for three weeks in July. It's going to be hard work, but I want to save some money. My uncle says I'm going to help in the kitchen and serve customers.

In August, I'm going to travel around Portugal with my cousin Leo. We're going to take trains from Porto to Lisbon and then go to the beaches in the south. We aren't going to stay in hotels because they're too expensive. We're going to stay in hostels and maybe camp for a few nights.
I'm also going to take a guitar course online. I've wanted to learn for years, and this summer I'm finally going to do it!
What about you? Are you going to visit your grandparents in Canada again? If you're free at the end of August, why don't you come to my house for a few days? We could go to the lake.
